name: nastown
description: NASTOWN — NAS storage website (React + Tailwind client, Express + PostgreSQL server)

scripts.install:all: npm install --prefix client && npm install --prefix server
scripts.dev: concurrently -n server,client -c cyan,magenta "npm run dev --prefix server" "npm run dev --prefix client"
scripts.build: npm run install:all && npm run build --prefix client
